name: AgentCat
description: Track how AI agents use your MCP server with session replay, intent capture and error and hallucination tracking, and query the analytics over MCP, for MCP server builders.

skills.name: Replay Sessions
skills.description: Searches and replays agent sessions on your MCP server step by step, showing each tool call and why the agent made it.

skills.name: Track Issues
skills.description: Finds the common errors and hallucinations agents hit on your MCP server and returns the details of each issue.

skills.name: Analyze Usage
skills.description: Returns project overviews, metric trends and breakdowns by client, server, location and model for your MCP traffic.

skills.name: Forward Telemetry
skills.description: Forwards enriched MCP telemetry to Datadog, Sentry, PostHog or any OpenTelemetry collector over OTLP.
